basic_details.job_title: MGU Course Mentor Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) Course Mentor (Online MBA) Notification 2026 has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website https://www.mgu.ac.in/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the MGU Course Mentor (Online MBA) Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years. Age relaxation is permitted to eligible categories as per rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject area (minimum 55% marks), NET / Ph.D (Subject to UGC ODL/OL Regulation 2020)
qualification.details: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject area of the concerned online programme (minimum 55% marks), NET / Ph.D (Subject to UGC ODL/OL Regulation 2020).

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Course Mentor (Online MBA) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Course Mentor (Online MBA) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Course Mentor position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Course Mentor (Online MBA) position is 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Course Mentor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject area with a minimum of 55% marks. NET or Ph.D. is also acceptable, subject to UGC ODL/OL Regulation 2020.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Course Mentor position is 50 years. Age relaxation may be provided to eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Course Mentor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete bio-data and required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC, SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MGU Course Mentor position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this role will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) is conducting this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 116383/ADA7-1/2023/VC SECTION.
